resolution_specific_2hourly_screen.gate_definition: At least 8 source-tagged animals, each >=4 original GPS fixes on >=10 distinct dates spanning >=30 elapsed days, and >=3 date overlaps with >=2 qualifying animals.

resolution_specific_slow_screen.gate_definition: At least 8 source-tagged animals, each >=2 original GPS fixes on >=20 dates spanning >=30 elapsed days and >=3 shared dates

main_takeaways: Snake tracking events are original radio-transmitter (not GPS), despite a published animal movement CSV and thousands of events.
Ukraine crane GPS source has 4 animal ID strings only, so fails min eight animals even before individual temporal checks.
Humboldt penguin hourly-averaged GPS source has 21 individuals but only 421 location events, so cannot pass dense 50-per-day four-day individualization support.
Wolf source-tag references explicitly state 2-hourly GPS fixes. Imposing 50 fixes/day would be impossible by its design and is an inappropriate bat-derived universal criterion.

Using separately specified source-cadence 2-hourly screening (4 fixes on >=10 dates across >=30 days), Wolf records contain 12 distinct tracked animal IDs and 10 satisfy preliminary repeated source-day support with 396 overlapping qualifying dates.

Even this Wolf source count PASS is not confirmed one conspecific/cohort/site population, ecological movement-choice identity, niche partitioning or a tested relation between the two. 3D altitude inference is not supported by GPS position alone.
Cadence-tier change was made after initial reference/event feasibility inspection and is explicitly exploratory before outcome measurements, not falsely preregistered.
